revocation.notice: A revocation keeps the grant and its usage in the ledger and does not refund allowance. Refunding is a separate operation.
refund.notice: A refund returns allowance units to the pool. It never moves a deadline.
exception.notice: For this learner only, outside every allowance pool. It changes {scope} explicitly; an earlier ancestor deadline still binds.
shortens: This shortens promised time for the learner.
reason.hint: A reference such as a ticket or decision number, not personal details.
